name: High Warden Maren
title: Castellan of Castle Silverfall
examine: Silver-haired and slow-moving, like the mountain: nothing about her hurries, and nothing about her stops.
lines: The mountain was here first. Everything I decide, I decide as its guest.
I ordered the seal broken. If that was wrong, the error is mine and the mountain may collect it from me personally.
Silverfall is not a city with a mine. It is a mine that learnt manners.
